title: Track installed guidance snippets and updates
description:
Design and implement a lightweight, reliable way for guidance-composer to determine:
- which guidance snippets are already installed
- whether any installed snippets need updating

Produce a proposal for principal approval before implementation.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Proposal documents the data model, detection algorithm, update semantics, and failure behavior.
2. Implementation begins only after proposal approval.
3. Installed snippets can be identified without expensive scanning or network dependence.
4. Changed source snippets are reported as needing update.
5. Tests cover installed, current, outdated, missing, and corrupted metadata cases.
notes:
Initial proposal was rejected because verbose per-ID/hash metadata would bloat the managed region.

Principal feedback verbatim: "I do NOT like this approach, it is going to heavily bloat the managed region, what about a bitmask?"

Follow-up requirement: design the smallest reliable bitmask-based representation. Explain why a bare installed mask is or is not sufficient for freshness, define stable catalog indexing/version semantics, migration and corruption behavior, and quantify managed-region bytes. Proposal only; do not implement.

title: Calibrate model routing from linked session outcomes
description: After the criteria review, design and implement a retrospective procedure in model-routing. For each recorded routing decision, link the actual launched worker session; at review time read every available linked session from its original store (do not retain Jev prompts or transcript copies in the routing journal). Define a thorough, multi-label work-domain taxonomy covering coding, architecture/systems design, 3D/spatial work, art/game visuals, UI, UX, writing, research, operations, and other observed work. Use Jev to classify domains and assess task outcome, defects, user-requested changes, abandonment, and uncertainty with a predeclared rubric. Separate user preference changes from errors and external abandonment from model failure; verify artifacts/acceptance where available. Store private assessment evidence locally and publish only aggregate, non-identifying findings. Calibrate per model/effort/domain with sample size, uncertainty, shrinkage for sparse cells, and bounded outlier influence; show useful early signals without premature claims. Compare Jev routing to a mechanical/agent baseline on comparable tasks. Revisit score dimensions, mixed benchmark scales, correlations, confidence interpretation, and preferences; replace obsolete score tables only when outcome evidence supports it. Pilot findings: docs/research/model-routing-retrospective-pilot-2026-09-24.md.
acceptance_criteria: A documented, reproducible retrospective pipeline processes linked sessions; ambiguous or unverified outcomes remain unscored; reports show domain-level quality with sample size and uncertainty; outliers cannot dominate; baseline comparison and migration criteria for current score tables are explicit; user can review before automatic score updates.
notes: Use docs/research/model-routing-value-proposal-2026-09-24.md as the starting design after criteria review. Retrospective unit is one delegated outcome with artifact/user evidence; Jev classifications alone cannot score visual quality. Add Score/Noul support and shadow-value evaluation before switching selectors.

title: Review model-routing criteria and Jev value
description: Review docs/research/model-routing-criteria-audit-2026-09-24.md and docs/research/model-routing-retrospective-pilot-2026-09-24.md with the user. Decide which routing criteria remain useful, whether Jev adds outcome value beyond mechanical gates, and which benchmark dimensions or preferences to revise before outcome calibration.
acceptance_criteria: User-reviewed criteria decisions are recorded; unresolved questions are explicit; the retrospective-calibration epic can then begin.
notes: Proposal for review: docs/research/model-routing-value-proposal-2026-09-24.md. Live pilot found meaningful task/domain classification but no linked verified worker outcomes; current catalog lacks art-quality data. Keep this review open until the user accepts or revises the proposed division of labor and outage fallback.
